_about: What's new on the site, shown at the top of the Reddit roundups for a week after `date`. Newest first; links are Markdown.

items.text: I'm working on a page just for local markets and winter festivals: [Markets & Festivals](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/markets-festivals-boston/)
